title: TotalEnergies Expands its Joint-Venture with KKR with the Addition of a 700 MW Renewables Portfolio
summary: TotalEnergies and KKR announced the signing of an agreement to add 700 MW to the 50/50 Joint-Venture (JV) they created in the U.S. in 2025, which currently hold
body_markdown:
**Paris, October 12, 2026** – TotalEnergies and KKR, a leading global investment firm, today announced the signing of an agreement to add 700 MW to the 50/50 Joint-Venture (JV) they[created](https://totalenergies.com/newsroom/renewables-totalenergies-divests-50-14-gw-solar-portfolio-north-america/?lang=eng) in the U.S. in 2025, which currently holds 1.4 GW.


The transaction covers a portfolio of three utility scale solar assets located in Texas and in Ohio which are expected to reach their commercial operation dates by the first quarter of 2027. The electricity produced by these assets is already sold to third parties or will be marketed by TotalEnergies. The transaction reflects an enterprise value of $1.2 billion for the portfolio.


TotalEnergies will continue to operate the assets after completion of the transaction, which is expected in 2026 subject to customary conditions.


## About KKR


KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR's insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR's investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries. For additional information about KKR & Co. Inc. (NYSE: KKR), please visit KKR's website at[www.kkr.com](http://www.kkr.com/) . For additional information about Global Atlantic Financial Group, please visit Global Atlantic Financial Group's website at[www.globalatlantic.com](http://www.globalatlantic.com/) .


## TotalEnergies and Electricity


[TotalEnergies](https://totalenergies.com/) is building a competitive portfolio that combines renewables (solar, onshore wind, offshore wind) and flexible assets (CCGT, storage) to deliver clean firm power to its customers. By the end of June 2026, TotalEnergies holds more than 37 GW of gross renewable power generation capacity and aims to achieve over 100 TWh of net electricity production by 2030.


## About TotalEnergies


TotalEnergies is a global integrated energy company that produces and markets energies: oil and biofuels, natural gas, biogas and low-carbon hydrogen, renewables and electricity. Our more than 100,000 employees are committed to provide as many people as possible with energy that is more reliable, more affordable and more sustainable. Active in about 120 countries, TotalEnergies places sustainability at the heart of its strategy, its projects and its operations.
